author: /root/h056_native_resume_v2
central_distinction: Joint dependence of ancestry transitions across persistent sampled haplotypes, rather than transporting or averaging learned clade states.
common_inputs: All original whole trees, vertices, sampled haplotypes, phased SNPs, distances, real sample/reference dates and observed reference labels.
hypothesis: A shared latent ancestry-switch factor supported by observed changed-clade descendants improves tract boundaries beyond equally informed independent-query switch factors and correspondence shams.
novelty_gate: Check primary joint-LAI/pedigree/SMC/shared-breakpoint/factor-graph literature and reject architectural priority if equivalent.
prospective_primary: At least1pp equal-parent mean1kb boundaryF1 gain versus BOTH matched controls, with no mean exact-span accuracy decrease.
